BiblicalUsage: This Aramaic word is simply sin, and Daniel tells Nebuchadnezzar to break off his sins by righteousness and his iniquities by showing mercy to the poor. The counsel is plain: stop the sin and start the mercy.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Daniel's counsel still stands: breaking off sin by righteousness is the way back to peace, and mercy to the poor is part of it.
